passUnavailable: You cannot pass when there are no cards on the table.
invalidCombo: Not a valid combination (single, pair, triple, straight, double-sequence, or four of a kind)

unplayable.typeMismatch: The combination type differs from the table play
unplayable.tooWeak: This play is weaker than the table play

rules.title: Combo strength and plays
rules.strength: Compare rank (3 is lowest, 2 is highest). Three-pair runs and four of a kind are chops; they beat a single 2 or a weaker chop.
rules.follow: When cards are on the table, play a stronger combo of the same type and count.
rules.lead: When the table is empty, play any valid combo. You cannot pass.

tutorial.tableCards: Cards on the table. Play the same combination type and count with higher rank.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Click cards to select them.
tutorial.playPass: Play selected cards or pass your turn.

frontendHint.tienlenLead: The table is clear — lead your weakest card
frontendHint.tienlenFollow: Play the weakest card that still beats the table
frontendHint.tienlenPass: Nothing in hand beats the table — pass
